On the transfer front, the revived interest in Kroupi ahead of January is the one to watch, though it's still developing rather than done, while Atlético and Athletic Club circling an Arsenal star and a €100m clause reportedly triggered by Arsenal's interest are only rumours for now. There's no "Here we go" today, so keep the party hats in the cupboard.
